tips.title: Tip:
tips.loseWeight: Safe weight loss rate is 0.5-0.75 kg per week. Too large deficit may lead to muscle mass loss.
tips.gainWeight: Optimal mass gain rate is 0.25-0.5 kg per week. This allows muscle building with minimal fat gain.
tips.maintain: Maintaining weight allows body recomposition - building muscle while reducing fat tissue.
tips.healthyLoss: Combine diet with strength training to preserve muscle mass.
tips.healthyGain: Regular strength training will help build muscle instead of fat tissue.
